beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But the book also asks what kind of society survives those repairs.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Emergency powers can harden into control even while essential services keep running.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its later chapters connect leadership, technology, and institutions that can admit mistakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final argument asks us to preserve rights, knowledge, and ways to correct errors.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the four kinds of ending, then follow the chapter on catastrophe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to distinguish staying alive from retaining the ability to build something better.
